text.tspan: Thunks travel as VM-owned root handles across collective request and OS launch
Pending startup roots are scanned independently of whether their execution thread is ready
Frozen manifest is immutable; late arrivals are staged and retain source roots
Receipt certifies persistent future membership not merely current scan or queued acceptance
Known rejection retains parent; unknown service result retains parent and startup record
Actual selected IR expressions and exact receipt scope bind model evidence

g.text: Freeze active root providers independently of worker readiness
Only known ownership can retire creator source
Late stage cannot change frozen manifest
Old scan views drain before restore
Selected meaning is not full simulation
New pending-root consumer needs actual source refinement
Actual launch cancellation stop and join obligations
